intro: I design, build and ship web products end to end, from the database to the pixels.
about: As a full-stack engineer with 3+ years building web applications, I help clients turn rough ideas into fast, dependable products. My home base is Ruby on Rails on the back end and React on the front end, and I am comfortable owning everything in between: API design, data modeling, UI, and the AWS infrastructure it all runs on.

I love the problem-solving side of engineering. Give me a vague requirement and I will ask the right questions, sketch the simplest solution, and get a working version in front of people quickly. I care about readable code, automated tooling like RuboCop and one-command deploys, and leaving a codebase better than I found it.
I also build my own products to stay sharp. Url 2 QR turns any link into a trackable QR code, and Meal Mixtures takes the guesswork out of meal planning. Both run serverless on AWS.
offline: When I'm not writing code, you'll find me cooking 🌮, at a concert 🎶, traveling by motorcycle 🏍, or hiking in the great outdoors 🏔.
